signature: SUBROUTINE ZTRTRS( UPLO, TRANS, DIAG, N, NRHS, A, LDA, B, LDB,

params.name: uplo
params.reference:
-   `= 'U'`: A is upper triangular;
-   `= 'L'`: A is lower triangular.

params.name: trans
params.reference:
Specifies the form of the system of equations:

-   `= 'N'`: $A \, X = B$     (No transpose)
-   `= 'T'`: $A^T \, X = B$  (Transpose)
-   `= 'C'`: $A^H \, X = B$  (Conjugate transpose)

params.name: diag
params.reference:
-   `= 'N'`: A is non-unit triangular;
-   `= 'U'`: A is unit triangular.

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: nrhs
params.reference: The number of right hand sides, i.e., the number of columns of the matrix B. $\mathrm{NRHS} \ge 0$.

params.name: A
params.reference: The triangular matrix A. If `UPLO = 'U'`, the leading N-by-N upper triangular part of the array A contains the upper triangular matrix, and the strictly lower triangular part of A is not referenced. If `UPLO = 'L'`, the leading N-by-N lower triangular part of the array A contains the lower triangular matrix, and the strictly upper triangular part of A is not referenced. If `DIAG = 'U'`, the diagonal elements of A are also not referenced and are assumed to be 1.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: B
params.reference: On entry, the right hand side matrix B. On exit, if `INFO = 0`, the solution matrix X.

params.name: ldb
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array B. $\mathrm{LDB} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
-   `> 0`: if `INFO = i`, the i-th diagonal element of A is zero, indicating that the matrix is singular and the solutions X have not been computed.
